Unlocking Earth AI’s planetary geospatial foundation models for global public health
summary: Google released Earth AI's Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM), a geospatial foundation model that compresses satellite imagery, mobility patterns, search trends, and environmental data into location embeddings for public health applications. Five case studies demonstrate PDFM improves epidemiological workflows: cross-border MMR vaccination prediction increased from 16% to 22% variance explained, CVD nowcasting matched census data with fresher inputs, dengue forecasting improved accuracy in 72% of active transmission areas one month ahead, postpartum depression screening reached 5,640 additional rural mothers annually, and cholera hotspot forecasting provided 4-8 week advance warning. The key takeaway is that pre-trained geospatial embeddings can plug directly into existing health models without task-specific fine-tuning, addressing data gaps and reporting lags endemic to traditional epidemiological surveillance.

title: Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses
summary: Microsoft Research Asia released Agent Lightning v1.0, a 3,500-line RL framework that trains agents using their actual deployment harness instead of reimplementing them. The key innovation is Harnessed Agentic RL, which intercepts model calls via an LLM proxy, eliminating costly harness reimplementation and train-deploy mismatches. It runs agents natively on Kubernetes without commercial sandbox dependencies and introduces Collocated Async RL for 2x speedup. Training Qwen3.5-9B on 6,000 samples improved SWE-bench Verified Pass@1 from 41.8% to 56.4%, demonstrating data-efficient agent improvement.

Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
summary: Liquid AI released d1-3B and d1-omni-600M, open-weight decision models optimized for edge inference that answer structured queries in single forward passes rather than generating tokens. d1-3B scores 82.9 on the Decision Index benchmark, outperforming larger models, while d1-omni-600M handles text with images or audio at 600M parameters. For builders deploying on-device AI, these models enable fast multimodal classification and QA—d1-3B answers questions in 16ms on Jetson AGX Thor and 50ms on Orin Nano. Key takeaway: use decision models when you need structured outputs with low latency; they're fundamentally different from generative models and excel at classification, intent detection, and decision tasks.

title: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
summary: NVIDIA's Nemotron achieved gold-medal performance at both IOI 2026 (535.4/600) and IMO 2026 (30/42) through a reusable specialization recipe: curating domain-specific data, applying SFT and RL, and pairing models with generate-verify-refine inference loops. For IOI, Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC with GenCorrect surpassed human performance; for IMO, complementary SFT and RL checkpoints worked together on proof generation and verification. The key insight is that neither fine-tuning alone nor brute-force sampling alone achieved these results—combining capable specialists with intelligent inference systems proved essential. NVIDIA released the models, datasets, and reproducible pipelines on Hugging Face.

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on vLLM: 5x Agentic Throughput Since Day 0
summary: vLLM achieved 5.3× throughput improvement for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on agentic workloads through system and kernel optimizations. Key techniques include SWA bounded replay with CUDA graphs (30% TTFT reduction), integration of DeepSeek's kernels like MegaAttention and Mega-Gate, and aggressive kernel fusion. For builders, this demonstrates how model-level efficiency features (causal encoder-decoder, FP4 KV cache, sparse attention) combined with system-level optimizations unlock dramatic performance gains. The takeaway: leverage model architecture properties like V4.1's 8B prefill/16B decode parameter activation split and bounded replay to reduce computation, then apply CUDA graphs and kernel fusion to eliminate overhead.
